QuestInfo.name: The Black Wings and the Puppeteer
QuestInfo.0: Go to #bInformant #p 1103001##k and hear about the #rPuppeteer#k.
QuestInfo.1: The #rBlack Wings' Puppeteer#k can use #rpuppets#k to #bcontrol monsters#k. It would help to know what the Puppeteer was like in the past, so get #b#o9300274##k and find the #rPuppeteer's Puppet#k.
QuestInfo.2: The ability to use puppets to #rcontrol a monster completely#k... In the past, the Puppeteer used these powers for evil on Victoria Island, and was then banished by the Cygnus Knights.

0.0: The #rPuppeteer#k, in particular, is one tough cookie. He can #bcontrol monsters with his dolls#k. I have dreams like that sometimes, only the dolls are my mom and we're in a cheesecake wonderland. That's normal, right?
0.1: It seems like old Neinypants wants you to hunt for #rtraces of the Puppeteer's past#k before you try to find him. I think he used to be pals with the #rOrange Mushrooms#k around #b#m100000000##k. Maybe they know something!
0.2: Go out to the #m100010001##k and hunt down the #rOrange Mushrooms that were influenced by the Puppeteer#k. If you can find #r15 Orange Mushroom Dolls#k, maybe you'll know more about him!

yes.0: You can spot a monster under the Puppeteer's control just by looking at #bits face#k.

no.0: Weren't you supposed to get some dolls or something? Why does that word make me think about cheesecake?

1.0: See? Now you can tell when a monster's been mind-controlled because of its #rweird personality#k. And then you can tell me everything else you learned, because I haven't left this box in two years.

yes.0: Some of the Cygnus Knights fought the Puppeteer before, but he #rhasn't given up#k. I bet he has scary dreams for the future of Victoria Island. Maybe he'll turn the whole place into a stage for his terrible shows!

item.0: You still didn't get the #bOrange Mushroom Dolls#k? They should be really obvious! Just look at the monsters' #rfaces#k.
